The conviction of Zeal grants many great powers. Wielding holy verse empowered by the echoes of [[phoenix]] song, there are few limits upon a [[Priest]]'s capabilities. From condemning a heretic to be plagued by visions of their sins to drawing upon their allies for a surge of healing power beyond any other, the vanguard of [[Creation]] stands ready to exact retribution upon any that would challenge the sanctity of their charge.

The skill of '''Zeal''' is available to members of the [[Priest]] class, along with [[Spirituality]] and [[Devotion]].

{{Skill_detail

 |detail=You may now chain holy verses together. Each verse you recite(*) somewhat quickly after a prior one will form a prayer; a prayer of two or more verses that you allow to finish without reciting further will

Conviction is used to enact some of the more powerful holy verses.<p>Additionally, certain verses can only be utilised once per prayer, and others may require a prayer of a certain length before they can be recited.<br>* Verses that specifically target yourself do not increase your prayer's length. Prayers that target others or that are somewhat indiscriminate do.</p>

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Rebuke
 |description=Punish their transgressions.
 |lessons=831
 |syntax=RECITE <verse> <target> REBUKE <sin>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your mastery of the holy verses now grants you the ability to conclude your prayer with a punishment of one of a heretics sins. Certain punishments require a prayer of longer length than others. The punishment is given alongside the standard verse effect:<br>'''Chaos''': requires a prayer of at least two verses, gives hallucinations.<br>'''Darkness''': requires a prayer of at least two verses, gives paranoia.<br>'''Evil''': requires a prayer of at least three verses, gives masochism.<br>'''Heresy''': requires a prayer of at least four verses. Gives the inquisition affliction to a target suffering from both the guilt and spiritburn afflictions.<p>Note that you may only couple rebuke with a verse that also targets a specific enemy.</p>
}}
